planets.name: HD 21749 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of GJ 143 with a 7.79-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: HD 21749 c was found in 2019 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around GJ 143. Its orbit and size follow Dragomir et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
